t: You're looking at Westminster Abbey, the Gothic church where 40 English and British monarchs have been crowned since 1066. Eighteen monarchs are buried here, and at least sixteen royal weddings have taken place since 1100. Elizabeth I, last of the Tudors, is buried here. The abbey also holds some of the great names of science and letters. Isaac Newton, whose Principia established classical mechanics, is buried here, and so is Charles Darwin, honoured by burial in the abbey. Stephen Hawking, once Lucasian Professor at Cambridge, is here too. Among the writers are Charles Dickens and Rudyard Kipling.
